page_title: INT 2-2 NAP | Inter v Napoli 11/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Here is a change. Matteo Politano is going off and Antonio Conte gives the last tactical orders to Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).
90+3' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the left post. Unlucky!
90+2' Juan Jesus (Napoli) will miss the next game.
90+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Juan Jesus (Napoli) was quite harsh and Daniele Doveri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+1' Noa Lang (Napoli) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) offside.
89' The attendance for today's match is 72567.
88' Cristian Chivu decides to make a substitution. Lautaro Martinez will be replaced by Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter).
88' The referee allows time for a substitution. Federico Dimarco will be replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
88' Cristian Chivu has decided to substitute Hakan Calhanoglu and he is replaced by Petar Sucic (Inter).
86' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
84' Inter failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
84' Luis Henrique (Inter) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Inter.
83' Cristian Chivu prepares a substitution. Marcus Thuram is replaced by Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter).
81' 2 - 2 Goal - 2:2! Scott McTominay (Napoli) receives a precise pass inside the box from Noa Lang and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
80' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
78' The substitution has been made. Noa Lang (Napoli) has replaced Sam Beukema.
76' Napoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
75' Juan Jesus (Napoli) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
73' 2 - 1 Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) brilliantly executes the penalty kick, sending the ball in off the right post! No chance for Vanja Milinkovic-Savic to stop this shot.
72' The expression of the referee Daniele Doveri is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) is shown a yellow card.
72' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is going to take the penalty!
71' Referee Daniele Doveri has finally had enough of Antonio Conte and gives him a straight RED CARD!
70' It’s a PENALTY to Inter after the VAR review!

69' Play continues despite the shouts by some Inter players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Daniele Doveri interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
68' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Vanja Milinkovic-Savic scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
68' Federico Dimarco (Inter) blows a good chance to score. He collects a pass inside the box, but his effort to the middle of the goal is brilliantly blocked. Great defending!
68' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
67' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Inter.
66' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
64' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
63' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
62' The substitution is prepared. Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Piotr Zielinski.
59' Nicolo Barella (Inter) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. He hits the ball poorly and sends it into orbit.
59' Daniele Doveri has a clear sight and sees a foul from Sam Beukema (Napoli).
58' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
57' Marcus Thuram (Inter) probably handled the ball.
56' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Scott McTominay (Napoli) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
56' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 51:49.
55' Napoli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
52' Nicolo Barella (Inter) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
51' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the left post.
50' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniele Doveri interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
48' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
47' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Matteo Politano (Napoli) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

45+1' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Yann Bisseck (Inter) inside the box. He lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Federico Dimarco (Inter) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
45' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Federico Dimarco (Inter).
45' A dangerous looking corner kick from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is cleared to safety by the defence. Inter force their opponents to concede a corner.

44' Marcus Thuram (Inter) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the roof of the net, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic is prepared and leaps to thwart him. It will be a corner kick for Inter.
44' Inter are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
43' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
40' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
39' Yann Bisseck (Inter) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
38' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
36' Marcus Thuram (Inter) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
34' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
33' Nicolo Barella (Inter) is in acres of space inside the box and lets fly with a shot which goes well wide of the right post. What a poor effort.
32' Marcus Thuram (Inter) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
31' Scott McTominay (Napoli) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Yann Sommer stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
31' A cross from Yann Bisseck (Inter) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
30' Marcus Thuram (Inter) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off the line to clear the ball away.

26' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Scott McTominay (Napoli) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Eljif Elmas. The score is now 1:1.
26' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Napoli.
24' 45:55 – the ratio of ball possession.
22' Marcus Thuram (Inter) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Daniele Doveri no option but to blow his whistle.
21' Marcus Thuram (Inter) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
19' Marcus Thuram (Inter) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
18' Dangerous play by Juan Jesus (Napoli). Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Inter, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
18' Marcus Thuram (Inter) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
17' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.
17' He should have scored! Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
15' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark.
14' The ball is cleared after Marcus Thuram (Inter) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
12' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic comes off the line to clear the ball away.
9' 1 - 0 Marcus Thuram plays a neat ball into the path of Federico Dimarco (Inter), who makes room for a shot and sends in a low drive which bounces in off the right post! 1:0.
8' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
7' The Napoli players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
5' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
3' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
2' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has just begun.
Napoli will kick-off.
